title: Shatrughna seizes Manthara and threatens to punish her
introduction: Shatrughna asks Bharata why even Lakshmana could not prevent Dasaratha from sending Rama to the forest. Meanwhile, when Manthara arrives at the scen, Shatrughna seizes her with his powerful hand, threatens to punish her and abuses Kaikeyi too. When Kaikeyi pleads for mercy with her son, Bharata intervenses and Shatrughna releases Manthara.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टसप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 78th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
अत्र यात्राम् समीहन्तम् शत्रुघ्नः लक्ष्मण अनुजः |
भरतम् शोक सम्तप्तम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
atra yātrām samīhantam śatrughnaḥ lakṣmaṇa anujaḥ |
bharatam śoka samtaptam idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Thereafter, Shatrughna the younger brother of Lakshmana spoke the following words to Bharata, who was tormented with grief and who desired to undertake an expedition to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
गतिर् यः सर्व भूतानाम् दुह्खे किम् पुनर् आत्मनः |
स रामः सत्त्व सम्पन्नः स्त्रिया प्रव्राजितः वनम्
verses.iast:
gatir yaḥ sarva bhūtānām duhkhe kim punar ātmanaḥ |
sa rāmaḥ sattva sampannaḥ striyā pravrājitaḥ vanam
verses.translation: "When that even-minded Rama is a refuge for all beings, how much more to tell about our seeking solace to him in our grief? He has been abandoned to the forest by a woman."

verses.devanagari:
बलवान् वीर्य सम्पन्नो लक्ष्मणो नाम यो अपि असौ |
किम् न मोचयते रामम् कृत्वा अपि पितृ निग्रहम्
verses.iast:
balavān vīrya sampanno lakṣmaṇo nāma yo api asau |
kim na mocayate rāmam kṛtvā api pitṛ nigraham
verses.translation: "Why the so-called Lakshmana, the strong and powerful man, even could not rescue Rama from distress by making our father to restrain from doing it?"

glosses.meaning: rama (from distress) kR^itvaa = by making pitR^inigraham = our father to restrain from doing it?

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वम् एव तु निग्राह्यः समवेक्ष्य नय अनयौ |
उत्पथम् यः समारूढो नार्या राजा वशम् गतः
verses.iast:
pūrvam eva tu nigrāhyaḥ samavekṣya naya anayau |
utpatham yaḥ samārūḍho nāryā rājā vaśam gataḥ
verses.translation: "By perceiving the prudence and imprudence in that wrong course adopted by the king, who has fallen into the clutches of a woman, Lakshmana should have restrained Dasaratha even at the beginning itself."

verses.devanagari:
इति सम्भाषमाणे तु शत्रुघ्ने लक्ष्मण अनुजे |
प्राग् द्वारे अभूत् तदा कुब्जा सर्व आभरण भूषिता
verses.iast:
iti sambhāṣamāṇe tu śatrughne lakṣmaṇa anuje |
prāg dvāre abhūt tadā kubjā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā
verses.translation: While Shatrughna the younger brother of Lakshmana was talking thus, the hump-backed Manthara duly adorned with all types of ornaments, appeared at the eastern gate.

glosses.meaning: adorned with all types of ornaments

verses.devanagari:
लिप्ता चन्दन सारेण राज वस्त्राणि बिभ्रती |
विविधम् विविधैस्तैस्तैर्भूषणैश्च विभूषिता
verses.iast:
liptā candana sāreṇa rāja vastrāṇi bibhratī |
vividham vividhaistaistairbhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitā
verses.translation: Anointed with a scent of sandal-wood and wearing royal clothes, she was bedecked with several kinds of ornaments of every description in various ways.

verses.devanagari:
मेखला दामभिः चित्रै रज्जु बद्धा इव वानरी |
बभासे बहुभिर्बद्धा रज्जुबद्देव वानरी
verses.iast:
mekhalā dāmabhiḥ citrai rajju baddhā iva vānarī |
babhāse bahubhirbaddhā rajjubaddeva vānarī
verses.translation: Studded with bright-coloured girdle-bands and many other excellent ornaments, Manthara appeared like a female-monkey tied with ropes!

verses.devanagari:
ताम् समीक्ष्य तदा द्वाह्स्थो भृशम् पापस्य कारिणीम् |
गृहीत्वा अकरुणम् कुब्जाम् शत्रुघ्नाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
tām samīkṣya tadā dvāhstho bhṛśam pāpasya kāriṇīm |
gṛhītvā akaruṇam kubjām śatrughnāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: Beholding that hump-backed Manthara, the very much sinful and insensitive woman, the door-keepers caught her and delivered her to Shatrughna (with the following words:)

verses.devanagari:
यस्याः कृते वने रामः न्यस्त देहः च वः पिता |
सा इयम् पापा नृशंसा च तस्याः कुरु यथा मति
verses.iast:
yasyāḥ kṛte vane rāmaḥ nyasta dehaḥ ca vaḥ pitā |
sā iyam pāpā nṛśaṃsā ca tasyāḥ kuru yathā mati
verses.translation: "Here is that sinful and cruel woman, by whose act Rama is in the forest and your father has laid down his body. Do with her, as you consider fitting."

verses.devanagari:
शत्रुघ्नः च तत् आज्ञाय वचनम् भृश दुह्खितः |
अन्तः पुर चरान् सर्वान् इति उवाच धृत व्रतः
verses.iast:
śatrughnaḥ ca tat āGYāya vacanam bhṛśa duhkhitaḥ |
antaḥ pura carān sarvān iti uvāca dhṛta vrataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words, Shatrughna who was very much in grief and was firmly resolute, spoke to all those inmates of that gynaecium, as follows:

glosses.meaning: who was very much in gief

verses.devanagari:
तीव्रम् उत्पादितम् दुह्खम् भ्रातृऋणाम् मे तथा पितुः |
यया सा इयम् नृशंसस्य कर्मणः फलम् अश्नुताम्
verses.iast:
tīvram utpāditam duhkham bhrātṛṛṇām me tathā pituḥ |
yayā sā iyam nṛśaṃsasya karmaṇaḥ phalam aśnutām
verses.translation: "Let this woman, who created serious misfortune to my brothers and my father, receive the fruit of her cruel act."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता च तेन आशु सखी जन समावृता |
गृहीता बलवत् कुब्जा सा तत् गृहम् अनादयत्
verses.iast:
evam uktā ca tena āśu sakhī jana samāvṛtā |
gṛhītā balavat kubjā sā tat gṛham anādayat
verses.translation: Speaking thus in the midst of her companions, he seized that hunch-backed woman with his powerful hand soon and she in turn made that mansion resound with her shrieks.

glosses.meaning: in the mist of her companions

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुभृश सम्तप्तः तस्याः सर्वः सखी जनः |
क्रुद्धम् आज्ञाय शत्रुघ्नम् व्यपलायत सर्वशः
verses.iast:
tataḥ subhṛśa samtaptaḥ tasyāḥ sarvaḥ sakhī janaḥ |
kruddham āGYāya śatrughnam vyapalāyata sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then, her companion, having conceived Shatrughna's anger and extremely agonised as they were, ran away helter-shelter in all directions.

verses.devanagari:
अमन्त्रयत कृत्स्नः च तस्याः सर्व सखी जनः |
यथा अयम् समुपक्रान्तः निह्शेषम् नः करिष्यति
verses.iast:
amantrayata kṛtsnaḥ ca tasyāḥ sarva sakhī janaḥ |
yathā ayam samupakrāntaḥ nihśeṣam naḥ kariṣyati
verses.translation: All the company of women there surmised as follows : "The way how he is coming up, he will surely slay us all"

verses.devanagari:
सानुक्रोशाम् वदान्याम् च धर्मज्ञाम् च यशस्विनीम् |
कौसल्याम् शरणम् यामः सा हि नो अस्तु ध्रुवा गतिः
verses.iast:
sānukrośām vadānyām ca dharmaGYām ca yaśasvinīm |
kausalyām śaraṇam yāmaḥ sā hi no astu dhruvā gatiḥ
verses.translation: "We shall take reguge with the compassionate, magnanimous, virtuous and illustrious Kausalya. Let her be the sure asylum for us."

verses.devanagari:
स च रोषेण ताम्र अक्षः शत्रुघ्नः शत्रु तापनः |
विचकर्ष तदा कुब्जाम् क्रोशन्तीम् पृथिवी तले
verses.iast:
sa ca roṣeṇa tāmra akṣaḥ śatrughnaḥ śatru tāpanaḥ |
vicakarṣa tadā kubjām krośantīm pṛthivī tale
verses.translation: That Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies, with his raging red eyes then violently dragged the crying hump-back along the floor.

verses.devanagari:
तस्या हि आकृष्यमाणाया मन्थरायाः ततः ततः |
चित्रम् बहु विधम् भाण्डम् पृथिव्याम् तत् व्यशीर्यत
verses.iast:
tasyā hi ākṛṣyamāṇāyā mantharāyāḥ tataḥ tataḥ |
citram bahu vidham bhāṇḍam pṛthivyām tat vyaśīryata
verses.translation: While that Manthara was violently dragged, here various colourful ornaments were scattered asunder here and there on the floor.

verses.devanagari:
तेन भाण्डेन सम्कीर्णम् श्रीमद् राज निवेशनम् |
अशोभत तदा भूयः शारदम् गगनम् यथा
verses.iast:
tena bhāṇḍena samkīrṇam śrīmad rāja niveśanam |
aśobhata tadā bhūyaḥ śāradam gaganam yathā
verses.translation: Thus, that splendid royal mansion scattered by those ornaments, appeared very much like an autumnal sky studded with innumerable stars.

verses.devanagari:
स बली बलवत् क्रोधात् गृहीत्वा पुरुष ऋषभः |
कैकेयीम् अभिनिर्भर्त्स्य बभाषे परुषम् वचः
verses.iast:
sa balī balavat krodhāt gṛhītvā puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ |
kaikeyīm abhinirbhartsya babhāṣe paruṣam vacaḥ
verses.translation: Shatrughna, the strong and the eminent man, thus violently seizing her with rage, sharply rebuked Kaikeyi and spoke harsh words to her.

verses.devanagari:
तैः वाक्यैः परुषैः दुह्खैः कैकेयी भृश दुह्हिता |
शत्रुघ्न भय सम्त्रस्ता पुत्रम् शरणम् आगता
verses.iast:
taiḥ vākyaiḥ paruṣaiḥ duhkhaiḥ kaikeyī bhṛśa duhhitā |
śatrughna bhaya samtrastā putram śaraṇam āgatā
verses.translation: Agonised very much by those harsh and painful words, Kiakeyi overwhelmed as she was with the fear of Shatrughna, took refuge with Bharata.

glosses.meaning: afflicted by the fear for Shatrughna

verses.devanagari:
ताम् प्रेक्ष्य भरतः क्रुद्धम् शत्रुघ्नम् इदम् अब्रवीत् |
अवध्याः सर्व भूतानाम् प्रमदाः क्षम्यताम् इति
verses.iast:
tām prekṣya bharataḥ kruddham śatrughnam idam abravīt |
avadhyāḥ sarva bhūtānām pramadāḥ kṣamyatām iti
verses.translation: Seeing that enraged Shatrughna, Bharata said: "Among all beings women are not to be killed. Hence she is to be pardoned."

verses.devanagari:
हन्याम् अहम् इमाम् पापाम् कैकेयीम् दुष्ट चारिणीम् |
यदि माम् धार्मिको रामः न असूयेन् मातृ घातकम्
verses.iast:
hanyām aham imām pāpām kaikeyīm duṣṭa cāriṇīm |
yadi mām dhārmiko rāmaḥ na asūyen mātṛ ghātakam
verses.translation: "If the pious Rama were not to express his displeasure with me for killing the mother, I would have killed this Kaikeyi, the ill-mannered and sinful woman."

verses.devanagari:
इमाम् अपि हताम् कुब्जाम् यदि जानाति राघवः |
त्वाम् च माम् चैव धर्म आत्मा न अभिभाषिष्यते ध्रुवम्
verses.iast:
imām api hatām kubjām yadi jānāti rāghavaḥ |
tvām ca mām caiva dharma ātmā na abhibhāṣiṣyate dhruvam
verses.translation: "If the virtuous Rama hears that the hunch-backed woman has been killed, it is sure that he will cease to talk to you or even to me."

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नः लक्ष्मण अनुजः |
न्यवर्तत ततः रोषात् ताम् मुमोच च मन्थराम्
verses.iast:
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā śatrughnaḥ lakṣmaṇa anujaḥ |
nyavartata tataḥ roṣāt tām mumoca ca mantharām
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Bharata, Shatrughna the younger brother of Lakshmana renouncing his guilty design forthwith released that Manthara.

verses.devanagari:
सा पाद मूले कैकेय्या मन्थरा निपपात ह |
निह्श्वसन्ती सुदुह्ख आर्ता कृपणम् विललाप च
verses.iast:
sā pāda mūle kaikeyyā mantharā nipapāta ha |
nihśvasantī suduhkha ārtā kṛpaṇam vilalāpa ca
verses.translation: Manthara fell at the feet of Kaikeyi, breathless, weeping piteously.

glosses.meaning: being very much afflicted with grief

verses.devanagari:
शत्रुघ्न विक्षेप विमूढ सम्ज्ञाम् |
समीक्ष्य कुब्जाम् भरतस्य माता |
शनैः समाश्वासयद् आर्त रूपाम् |
क्रौन्चीम् विलग्नाम् इव वीक्षमाणाम्
verses.iast:
śatrughna vikṣepa vimūḍha samGYām |
samīkṣya kubjām bharatasya mātā |
śanaiḥ samāśvāsayad ārta rūpām |
krauncīm vilagnām iva vīkṣamāṇām
verses.translation: Seeing the hunch-backed woman, who was distraught on account of shatrughna's violence, wearing a disturbed appearance and looking like a crane that has been caught in a noose, Bharata's mother slowly consoled her.

glosses.meaning: who was distraught on account of Shatrughna's vioulence
that has been caught in a noose
